content.title: Christianity & secular thought
content.subtitle: Meaning, morality and the question of God.
content.description: Explore the positive claims people make about a life without religious belief. Humanism is one starting point, not a label for every nonreligious person.

christian.text: No fallen person is righteous by nature. God's image remains; common grace enables beneficial acts that cannot justify us.

other.text: Modern humanism affirms ethical responsibility and human flourishing without requiring religious belief.

christian.text: God reveals himself in creation and Scripture. Our reasoning serves his Word; it does not grant the Word authority.

other.text: The Humanists International declaration calls for reason, evidence and free inquiry. Ask which commitments your neighbour shares.

christian.text: Understanding a natural process does not remove its dependence on the Creator who sustains all things.

other.text: The declaration advocates science and free inquiry, and says its opinions are not based on revelations fixed for all time.
